---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement to the SkillMirror AI workflow
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Who experiences the problem, and in what situation?

## Desired outcome

What should the user be able to do?

## Proposed approach

Describe your idea without assuming a particular implementation is required.

## How could we verify it works?

List observable acceptance criteria or a simple test scenario.

## Risks and constraints

Consider privacy, accessibility, unreliable visual evidence, instructor review, and whether the feature could imply unsupported safety certification.

## Alternatives considered

What existing workflow or simpler approach could solve the same problem?
